messages:
Olivia (CS): putting this thread here — escalated ticket from two customers reporting non-English outputs regressed after yesterday's rollout. they pasted examples, see below.

Olivia (CS): customer A (EU) sent this repro (swedish prompt -> expected swedish answer but got english):

```
POST /v1/generate
Authorization: Bearer <redacted>
{
  \"model\": \"redwood-3.1\",
  \"input\": \"Översätt följande till svenska: 'How do I reset my API key?'\",
  \"max_tokens\": 80
}
```

Response (what they got):
```
{
  \"id\": \"resp_123\",
  \"output\": \"To reset your API key, go to Settings > API Keys...\"
}
```

Olivia (CS): customer B (Nordics) reported similar but in polish -> expected polish translation, got english, and in one case partially garbled utf-8 characters. both started seeing this after the v3.1 rollout yesterday (~03:10 UTC).

Priya (CS Lead): ticket IDs: #67842 and #67890. Both are paying mid-market customers on dedicated plans (eu-west1). They flagged impact: 2k+ monthly calls, visible user complaints.

Raj (Eng-ML): thanks — quick q: which model variant did we promote in the rollout? was it a quantized variant or kernel change?

Sasha (Eng-Platform): rollout notes: promoted `redwood-3.1` default to `redwood-3.1-optq` for eu-west1 canary -> global at ~03:12 UTC. change included int8 quantization path and a new tokenizer mapping tweak for non-latin scripts. recorded in deploy log: deploy/2026-03-14-03:12 - id dpl_20260314_0312.

Lee (Oncall): pinging infra — any errors in container logs or charset transforms? could be a unicode normalization bug introduced with tokenizer tweak.

Raj (Eng-ML): that matches my suspicion. optq path had an experimental tokenizer normalization switch (NFKC -> enabled) to handle some whitespace cases. NFKC can affect non-latin characters in edge cases. if the tokenizer now normalizes inputs differently, model might receive slightly altered tokens and fall back to English-heavy distribution.

Olivia (CS): i pulled the exact customer payload and ran a local reproduce using `redwood-3.1-optq` in eu-west1 repro environment. repro steps:

```
# curl repro
curl -s -X POST https://eu-west1.api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H \"Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN\" \
  -H \"Content-Type: application/json\" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-3.1-optq","input":"Översätt följande till svenska: 'How do I reset my API key?'","max_tokens":80}'
```

Olivia (CS): output from canary node: `To reset your API key, go to Settings > API Keys...` (english). On older pinned `redwood-3.0` it returns proper swedish: `För att återställa din API-nyckel, gå till Inställningar > API-nycklar...`.

Raj (Eng-ML): good repro. can you paste the tokenized byte sequence differences? need to see if input normalization changed.

Sasha (Eng-Platform): i grabbed tokenizer debug logs from canary and stable for the same input. differences: canary normalized curly apostrophes and converted some unicode punctuation; stable preserved the raw ascii apostrophe. also canary produced an extra control token before the language tag for polish/swedish which likely shifted the attention distribution.

Priya (CS Lead): customers asking for quick mitigation — what's our recommended next step? rollback to previous tokenizer behavior? temporary traffic split?

Raj (Eng-ML): options:
- Immediate hotfix: disable the NFKC normalization flag in optq tokenizer config and restart canary nodes (low risk)
- Quick rollback: revert traffic for eu-west1 to `redwood-3.0` or `redwood-3.1` stable (higher impact operationally for feature parity)
- Longer: retrain small tokenizer mapping to preserve non-latin tokens while keeping other fixes.

Sasha (Eng-Platform): i can flip the tokenizer flag in the config and roll canary back within ~20 minutes. if we do that, we should add a regression test for Swedish/Polish translation prompts to CI.

Lee (Oncall): i can coordinate the rollback window with minimal disruption. recommend doing a canary revert to test nodes first. scheduling: 10:20 UTC approved?

Olivia (CS): customer-facing plan: send interim reply acknowledging the regression, ETA ~30-60m for a mitigation, ask for any additional repro examples (they already supplied 3). i drafted a message: \"we're investigating a regression introduced during last night's rollout that affects some non-English outputs in eu-west1. engineering is testing a mitigation now; we expect an update in ~30-60 minutes. sorry for the disruption.\"

Priya (CS Lead): +1. include ticket numbers and note we'll follow up after mitigation with root cause and permanent fix ETA.

DeployBot: deploy action queued: toggle `tokenizer_nfkc` -> false for namespace `eu-west1/canary` by Sasha at 2026-03-14T10:18:12Z.

Sasha (Eng-Platform): toggled flag and restarted canary nodes. monitoring logs now. i see immediate change in tokenizer debug: no extra control token and outputs revert to localized language in smoke tests.

Olivia (CS): verified with customer payload — now returns swedish translation. notifying customers and closing the urgent escalation pending RCA.

Raj (Eng-ML): next steps: create a small regression test set for non-latin translations (sv, pl, ja, zh) and add to pre-rollout checks; also track tokenizer config as a deploy-time tweak in rollout checklist.

Priya (CS Lead): thanks team. i will update the tickets and send a short post-mortem to the customers this afternoon with mitigation and plan.

Lee (Oncall): leaving a follow-up task: ENG-INC-1245 for permanent fix and CI tests.

Olivia (CS): closing loop here. will add the repro commands and responses to the ticket thread. :white_check_mark:
